journey.name: cold start activity
journey.description: Verifies that Home's recent transactions and All Activity remain consistent across cold starts. Requires an onboarded English-language wallet with at least four visible transactions and space for at least one recent activity row on Home. Use a wallet with an outgoing RBF boost if available, and note the replacement and original transactions before starting. This is an iOS-specific cache regression: the duplicate full-history scans are proved by BoostTxIdsCacheTests.swift, not inferred from screen timing. Those tests also inject refresh failures to verify the last successful value is retained, without allowing a wallet wipe or invalidation to restore old data. No new transactions should arrive during the comparison.

actions.action: Launch Bitkit, unlock if required, and verify Home (id "HomeScrollView") shows at least one recent activity row (id "ActivityShort-0")
Note the amounts, directions, and order of the visible recent transactions
Stop the app with `xcodebuildmcp simulator stop --bundle-id to.bitkit` and relaunch with `xcodebuildmcp simulator launch-app --bundle-id to.bitkit`
Unlock if required and wait for the recent transactions to appear on Home
Verify the recent transactions have the same amounts, directions, and order as before the cold start
Tap "Show All" (id "ActivityShowAll") and verify the newest transactions match Home's recent transactions in the same order
If the wallet has the noted outgoing RBF boost, verify its replacement is listed and its replaced original is absent
Navigate back to Home, then tap "Show All" again and verify the same transaction list appears
